originalFamilyScopeSummary: Enable cross margin mode for Pro traders to share collateral across positions and reduce liquidation risk
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: feat(perps): mobile | Pro mode | Cross margin
notes: This PR is deliberately the display slice of TAT-3519, not the full family scope. Its own description states 'This draft covers the existing-position display slice of TAT-3519. The Pro picker remains disabled.' The diff (14 files) adds Cross badges, a null/numeric liquidation explanation, the PerpsCrossMarginInfoButton tooltip and a non-editable 'Margin used' label — it lets traders read and understand existing Cross positions, but does not let them select cross margin mode for a new order, which is what the family scope's 'enable cross margin mode' requires. The order-side capability lives in Core #10136 (explicit OrderParams.marginMode, venue capability validation, Cross passed to updateLeverage); that Core change has now merged and shipped in @metamask/perps-controller 16.2.0, which main pulled in, but the Mobile Pro margin-mode picker remains disabled in this branch. This pr-complete run made no scope change of its own: it rebased onto main, independently re-verified all five flaky-test findings as false positives, and made zero code edits. Verdict is partial-symptom-only against the family scope, while being complete against this PR's own stated slice.
